bio_en: Artashes Devian, known as Yegiptatsi ('the Egyptian') and by the aliases Hovsep, Hayk and Mustafa, was a broad-shouldered, striking man whose seven years of revolutionary life were 'one long heroism'. As an ARF operative in Constantinople he would study a target like a secret policeman and stay at the scene until the sentence was carried out, returning disguised as a curious passer-by to confirm the death. He himself proposed to carry out the plan to kill the Sultan with a bomb on the 15th of Ramadan in 1896. He did not die rifle in hand on the battlefield; he died in 1897.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Years 1868-1897 from the title; manner of death not read.
